cases.name: base
cases.covers: Every distinction the base shell makes: an indirect annotation, a direct one with /NM, a direct one without, the three /RT cases, present-but-empty against absent strings, /EMBD_Metadata, a reversed /Rect, and a /Sound that no reader claims.

annotations.contents: a direct object that named itself
a direct object with no name
a direct object whose name is empty

cases.name: kinds
cases.covers: One annotation per geometry subtype, paired so each resolved default sits beside an explicit entry: a decorated square against a bare circle, a strikeout with /IT against one without, highlighter ink against pen ink, and a highlight with no /C against an underline with one.

cases.name: form
cases.covers: A widget reachable from /AcroForm beside an inert one, which is what the widget-to-field join has to tell apart. Nothing else in the corpus has a form at all.

cases.name: no-annotations
cases.covers: A document with no /Annots at all. The empty listing is a different answer from a failed one and nothing else here would catch a reader that confused them.

cases.name: report
cases.covers: A real multi-page document, whose annotations are whatever its producer wrote.
